text:
maya: Quick heads-up — Lantern release notes draft is ready for internal review. Target change window Tue 02:00 UTC. Need ops pin + rollback plan. I propose pinning model to v2.3.1-rc5 for GA, canary at v2.3.2-beta in EU region. @samir can you confirm cross-region staging availability?

samir: Yep staging has capacity Tue 01:00-03:00 UTC. Canary to EU ok. Will run perf smoke at 01:30. I'll also pre-warm KV cache.

hannah: LGTM on copy. Small ask: add a note about embedding cost change and new batching defaults. I can push a one-line blurb to the RN.

lila: +1. For rollback plan — recommend two-step rollback: 1) disable traffic via route flag, 2) revert model pin to v2.3.0 and drain. Can we add an escape-hatch doc? :wrench:

maya: Adding that now. Draft snippet below for internal announce — please thumbs-up or edit.

maya: ```
Heads-up: Lantern release rolling Tue 02:00 UTC. Expected impact: improved latency on long contexts; cost tuning enabled. If you see errors, please alert #eng-oncall and tag @hannah. Rollback: route flag -> revert to v2.3.0.
``` 

tony: copy looks good. Suggest we include minimal rollback commands in the RN for oncall. E.g.

tony: ```
# Rollback quick commands
deploy-bot rollback --service=lantern --to-version=v2.3.0
# or remove canary
deploy-bot set-route --service=lantern --percentage=0 --stage=canary
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduling canary rollout at 2024-06-25T01:30:00Z. Canary pool: eu-west-1 (2x T4g). Monitoring: latency, oom, error-rate.

samir: Noted. I'll open a short smoke-run thread at 01:25 and paste perf numbers.

lila: I'll update the escape-hatch doc and link it in the final RN. ETA 45m.

maya: Great — plan: finalize RN in 1h, pin in deploy config, run canary Tue 01:30, blast Tue 02:00. If no major regressions, promote. If we see >1% error-rate or latency p50 regresses by 30% -> rollback. :white_check_mark:

hannah: :thumbsup: I'll be on standby and will post in thread if we need to revert.

maya: Thanks team — I'll post the internal announce after final edits. ping me for any last minute changes.
